lace.webp.title: Needlepoint (Point Alençon) Lace Bonnet Veil, 1936.179
lace.webp.artist: Unknown artist (object); Cleveland Museum of Art (photo and open-access release)
lace.webp.changes: Cropped an 800px patch of floral sprigs on tulle from a 2000px rendition, converted luminance to alpha (dark ground becomes transparent, tulle net stays faintly visible), tinted ivory-white, mirrored 2x2 into a seamless 720px tile, WebP (164 KB). Replaces the earlier 1714 Belgian doily texture.
